items.prompt: A strategy totals -105 cents. What display preserves the signed money value?

options.why: Splitting the negative amount with floor quotient/remainder gives the wrong magnitude interpretation.
Dropping the sign changes a loss to a gain.
Separate the minus sign and format the absolute 105-cent magnitude with two decimals.
The fractional cents need a leading zero.

items.explanation: Separate the minus sign and format the absolute 105-cent magnitude with two decimals.
